articles.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin buys, adding $370 million of BTC last week
articles.snippet: It's the first week of bitcoin purchases for the Michael Saylor-led company in about two months.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain beats Ethereum in daily revenue as memecoin trading takes over
articles.snippet: The two-month-old network processed a record 5.52 million transactions on Aug. 30 as users launched 22,600 tokens and memecoin trading tools drove most of the $2.66 million in revenue.

articles.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin eyes 25% gain in August, best month since November 2024
articles.snippet: The price of crude oil is surging higher after overnight military strikes in Iran, with Trump once again proclaiming victory.

articles.title: Michael Saylor hints at first bitcoin purchase in two months
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rebounds from Friday’s low as Strategy’s valuation expands and bitcoin dominance climbs above 60%.
